abstract: Addressing the massive test score gaps between rich and poor countries will require programs that are both high-impact and scalable. This study uses the results of a randomized controlled trial in low-fee private schools in Ghana to study a program that meets both needs. The Tools for Foundational Learning Improvement program increased test scores by 0.5 standard deviation after just nine months of intervention. A machine learning method decomposes the effects by predicted test scores if the students did not receive the treatment, and the findings show that the gains were larger for weaker students. Moreover, the program’s impacts scale roughly linearly with time compared to a shorter-term, smaller-scale pilot randomized controlled trial. The program’s developers used generative artificial intelligence to accelerate lesson plan development and adaptation to new settings. An observational pilot test of this adaptation in Uganda yielded comparable results to those of this study’s randomized controlled trial. The study developed a model in which basic skills constrain the development of advanced skills, which predicts the pattern of effects observed across early reading capabilities, and it makes forecasts about the future impacts of the program as it continues into second grade.
abstract_zh: 解决富国与穷国之间巨大的考试成绩差距，需要兼具高影响力和可扩展性的项目。本研究利用加纳低收费私立学校的一项随机对照试验结果，考察了一个同时满足这两项需求的项目。基础学习提升工具项目在仅九个月的干预后，将考试成绩提高了0.5个标准差。通过机器学习方法，根据学生未接受干预时的预测考试成绩分解项目效果，结果显示较弱学生的收益更大。此外，与一项短期、小规模的试点随机对照试验相比，该项目的影响大致随时间线性扩展。项目开发者利用生成式人工智能加速教案开发及对新环境的适应。在乌干达进行的该适应性调整的观察性试点测试，得出了与本研究随机对照试验相当的结果。本研究构建了一个模型，其中基础技能制约高级技能的发展，该模型预测了早期阅读能力中观察到的效果模式，并对项目持续至二年级时的未来影响进行了预测。

abstract: Despite its conceptual appeal, the autoregressive inverse‐Wishart (AIW) multivariate stochastic volatility model has been hindered by inefficient sampling methods. The existing samplers for the latent covariance matrix severely suffer from the curse of dimensionality and only work when the dimension is very low. In this paper, we introduce a new proposal for the latent covariance matrix in the AIW model, which demonstrates far better scalability. We introduce different extensions to the basic AIW model that capture various stylized volatility features. We further fit the AIW model into a factor structure and provide an a posteriori identification procedure without introducing order dependence. When evaluated using real datasets ranging from 10 assets to 1000 assets, the new AIW‐based models, whether the standalone versions or the factor versions, are especially suited for multivariate volatility modeling in a wide range of dimensions.
abstract_zh: 尽管自回归逆威沙特（AIW）多元随机波动模型在概念上具有吸引力，但其低效的采样方法一直制约其应用。现有针对潜在协方差矩阵的采样器严重受困于维度灾难，仅能在极低维度下运行。本文为AIW模型中的潜在协方差矩阵提出了一种新方案，该方案展现出显著更优的可扩展性。我们引入基础AIW模型的不同扩展形式，以捕捉各类典型波动特征。进一步将AIW模型嵌入因子结构，并设计了一种无需引入顺序依赖的后验识别程序。基于10至1000个资产规模的真实数据集评估表明，无论是独立版本还是因子版本的新型AIW模型，均特别适用于广泛维度下的多元波动率建模。
title: The Autoregressive Inverse‐Wishart Multivariate Stochastic Volatility Model and Its Factor Extension
title_zh: 自回归逆威沙特多元随机波动模型及其因子扩展

abstract: Our study provides the first causal test of classical and behavioral asset pricing models that incorporate skewness pricing. In line with these models, our experimental markets show that skewness is systematically priced. Our findings also reveal that positively skewed assets available in small supply exhibit negative expected returns, which is consistent with prospect theory, but not with expected utility models. Furthermore, in line with the mechanism underlying prospect theory, we show that the negative returns of the positively skewed asset are most pronounced during market sessions where traders overweight the low probability of receiving a large payoff. (JEL C92, G10, G40)

abstract: Farm size, as well as technical and environmental efficiency in agriculture, is key to food security and sustainable development. However, empirical evidence about how heterogeneity across farm sizes is associated with the joint production of desirable outputs and undesirable by‐products remains limited, preventing our understanding of technical and environmental efficiency. Using country‐representative survey data on rice production in China from 2014 to 2018, we estimate farm‐level technical and environmental efficiency by employing a by‐production function combined with a stochastic meta‐frontier approach, accounting for heterogeneous technology across farm sizes. Our findings reveal considerable room to improve both technical and environmental performance, and the extent of both differs markedly by farm size. Medium‐sized farms (2–6.67 ha) exhibit the highest meta‐frontier technical efficiency, whereas large farms (6.67–33.33 ha) achieve the highest meta‐frontier environmental efficiency. The estimated shadow prices indicate that the mean marginal abatement cost of nitrogen pollution is 129.233 yuan/kg. We also identify a range of farm‐scale factors, such as technical training, land consolidation, higher educational attainment, and cooperative membership, which are significantly associated with higher levels of technical and environmental efficiency in rice farming. Counterfactual simulations further indicate that combining farm‐size‐specific measures could enhance meta‐frontier technical and environmental efficiency. In particular, cooperative participation is positively associated with technical and environmental performance among smallholders, while high‐level education and technical training are more impactful at large farms. Land fragmentation is consistently associated with lower efficiency and wider technology gaps across farm sizes. Our findings underscore the importance of designing farm‐size‐specific policies and implementing integrated interventions in promoting sustainable agricultural development.
abstract_zh: 农业经营规模以及技术效率与环境效率是粮食安全与可持续发展的关键。然而，关于不同规模农场在联合生产期望产出与非期望副产品方面的异质性如何影响技术效率与环境效率，现有实证证据仍然有限，这制约了我们对相关问题的理解。利用2014年至2018年中国水稻生产的全国代表性调查数据，我们采用联合生产函数结合随机元前沿方法，在考虑不同规模农场技术异质性的基础上，估算了农场层面的技术效率与环境效率。研究结果表明，技术绩效与环境绩效均有较大提升空间，且不同规模农场的提升幅度存在显著差异。中型农场（2–6.67公顷）的元前沿技术效率最高，而大型农场（6.67–33.33公顷）的元前沿环境效率最高。估算的影子价格显示，氮污染的平均边际减排成本为129.233元/千克。我们还发现一系列农场规模相关因素，如技术培训、土地整合、更高教育水平及合作社成员身份，与水稻种植中更高的技术效率与环境效率显著相关。反事实模拟进一步表明，结合针对特定规模农场的措施可提升元前沿技术效率与环境效率。具体而言，合作社参与与小农户的技术绩效和环境绩效呈正相关，而高等教育水平和技术培训对大型农场的影响更为显著。土地细碎化则始终与较低效率及更大技术差距相关，且这一关联在不同规模农场中普遍存在。研究结果强调了制定针对不同规模农场的政策并实施综合干预措施对促进农业可持续发展的重要性。

abstract: The enhancement of carbon productivity necessitates the deployment of cleaner technologies, the establishment of robust policy frameworks, and the optimization of production factor allocation. This study examines the effect of energy misallocation on total factor carbon productivity (TFCP) using stochastic frontier analysis across 73 countries. Employing panel data from 1991 to 2023, we construct country-level relative misallocation indices for energy, capital, and labour, based on deviations between observed and theoretically efficient factor input shares. Our methodology involves fixed-effects models and several robustness checks, including dynamic panel analysis and policy-heterogeneity tests. The results reveal a strong negative correlation between energy misallocation and TFCP, whereas the impacts of capital and labour misallocation are comparatively weaker and less consistent. Energy over-allocation imposes a greater productivity cost than under-allocation, indicating that excessive energy consumption significantly impedes carbon-adjusted efficiency. This deleterious effect intensifies in later periods, coinciding with increases in economic scale, energy demand, and carbon constraints. Nevertheless, policy-heterogeneity tests, utilizing Environmental Policy Stringency indicators, demonstrate that environmental policies, particularly market-based instruments, partially attenuate this effect by strengthening price signals and incentivizing structural adjustments. These findings highlight energy allocation efficiency as a critical mechanism through which low-carbon transition policies can advance carbon productivity. abstract_zh: 提升碳生产率需要部署清洁技术、建立稳健的政策框架并优化生产要素配置。本研究运用随机前沿分析法，考察了73个国家能源错配对全要素碳生产率（TFCP）的影响。基于1991至2023年的面板数据，我们根据实际要素投入份额与理论有效份额的偏离程度，构建了国家层面的能源、资本和劳动力相对错配指数。研究方法包括固定效应模型及多项稳健性检验，如动态面板分析和政策异质性检验。结果表明，能源错配与全要素碳生产率呈显著负相关，而资本和劳动力错配的影响则相对较弱且一致性较差。能源过度配置比配置不足造成的生产率损失更大，表明能源过度消耗显著阻碍了碳调整效率。这种负面效应在后期阶段加剧，与经济规模、能源需求和碳约束的增加同步。然而，利用环境政策严格度指标进行的政策异质性检验表明，环境政策（尤其是市场型工具）通过强化价格信号和激励结构调整，部分缓解了这一效应。这些发现揭示了能源配置效率是低碳转型政策提升碳生产率的关键机制。关键词：能源错配 全要素碳生产率 资源扭曲 环境规制 气候政策 JEL分类：Q43 Q54 O47 D24
title: Factor distortions and carbon efficiency: the case of energy misallocation
title_zh: 要素扭曲与碳效率：能源错配的案例研究

abstract: Enhancing supply chain transparency through corporate social responsibility (CSR) disclosure has become a key instrument of sustainability governance. Yet whether such mandates alter cross-border supply chain configurations remains theoretically debated and empirically unresolved. Using Chinese listed firms from 2010 to 2022, this study examines the impact of the EU Non-Financial Reporting Directive (NFRD) on supply chain relationships between Chinese suppliers and EU customers. We document a significant decoupling effect: after the NFRD, Chinese firms experience a substantial reduction in EU customer ties, especially when they had low pre-treatment CSR performance. Cross-sectional analysis reveals that the impact of the NFRD on the customer relationships of Chinese firms is more pronounced when supply chain CSR risk visibility is higher and the transmission of regulatory pressure from customers is greater. By identifying the cross-border spillover effects of a unilateral disclosure policy on firms in a non-implementing country, this study provides evidence on the real effects of mandatory CSR disclosure on global supply chain restructuring. KEYWORDS: Social responsibility mandatory disclosure supply chain disruption emerging market JEL CLASSIFICATION: M14 G38 L14

abstract_zh: 通过企业社会责任（CSR）披露提升供应链透明度已成为可持续治理的关键工具。然而，此类强制要求是否会改变跨境供应链配置，在理论上仍存争议，且缺乏实证证据。本研究以2010至2022年中国上市公司为样本，考察欧盟《非财务报告指令》（NFRD）对中国供应商与欧盟客户之间供应链关系的影响。我们发现了显著的脱钩效应：NFRD实施后，中国企业拥有的欧盟客户关系大幅减少，尤其当这些企业在指令实施前CSR表现较差时更为明显。横截面分析表明，当供应链CSR风险可见度更高、客户传递的监管压力更大时，NFRD对中国企业客户关系的影响更为突出。通过识别单边披露政策对非实施国企业的跨境溢出效应，本研究为强制性CSR披露对全球供应链重构的真实影响提供了证据。关键词：社会责任 强制披露 供应链中断 新兴市场 JEL分类：M14 G38 L14

abstract: This primer provides a systematic introduction to proportional representation (PR) electoral systems for scholars and students unfamiliar with their mechanics and political consequences. PR is now used for legislative elections in approximately 118 countries, making it the world’s most common family of electoral systems. However, its formal structure and political effects are often poorly understood outside specialist communities. The primer covers the main families of apportionment algorithms (quota, divisor, and ranked-choice methods), the principal types of PR electoral systems (list PR, STV, mixed, and semi-proportional), and their key structural components, including district magnitude, thresholds, measures of disproportionality, volatility, and the effective number of parties. It surveys major empirical regularities, including Duverger’s Law, the impact of district magnitude on party fragmentation, women’s and minority representation, voter turnout, and coalition formation, before turning to paradoxes and problems, including apportionment paradoxes and the Balinski–Young impossibility theorem, STV Non-Monotonicity and the No-Show paradox, spoilers and ballot-position primacy effects in list PR, and overhang seats and decoy parties in mixed compensatory systems. The primer concludes that every apportionment method is formally flawed, that institutional parameters interact with strategic behavior in ways that frequently produce unexpected outcomes, and that the empirical regularities anchoring the field rest on identification strategies that are vulnerable to the endogeneity of electoral institutions. A Glossary of key concepts is included as an Appendix.
abstract_zh: 本导论为不熟悉比例代表制（PR）运作机制及其政治后果的学者与学生提供了系统性入门介绍。目前约有118个国家在立法选举中采用比例代表制，使其成为全球最普遍的选举制度家族。然而，其正式结构及政治影响在专业领域之外常被误解。本文涵盖席位分配算法的主要类别（配额法、除数法与排序选择法）、比例代表制的主要类型（名单比例代表制、单一可转移投票制、混合制与半比例代表制）及其关键结构性要素，包括选区规模、门槛、比例性失衡指标、波动性及有效政党数。在探讨悖论与问题前，本文梳理了主要经验规律，包括迪韦尔热定律、选区规模对政党碎片化的影响、女性与少数群体代表性、选民投票率及联盟形成机制；随后转向分配悖论与巴林斯基-杨不可能定理、单一可转移投票制的非单调性与缺席悖论、名单比例代表制中的搅局者与选票位置优先效应，以及混合补偿制中的超额席位与掩护政党。本文结论指出：每种分配方法均存在形式缺陷；制度参数与策略行为互动常产生非预期结果；支撑该领域的经验规律所依赖的识别策略易受选举制度内生性问题影响。附录包含关键概念词汇表。

abstract: We study how sovereign risk fluctuations propagate to the real economy when banks hold long-term public debt. Using Italian data, we decompose spread-implied default probabilities into a systematic debt-driven component and an exogenous component capturing shifts in perceived sovereign risk. We embed this decomposition in a quantitative New-Keynesian model with constrained financial intermediaries and endogenous default risk, solved to a third order and estimated by simulated method of moments. Higher perceived default risk lowers sovereign bond prices, weakens bank net worth, tightens intermediary constraints, and depresses investment and output. Because default risk also responds to debt dynamics, the downturn amplifies sovereign risk through a sovereign-bank loop. We find that sovereign risk shocks account for about one fifth of output fluctuations and roughly one third of welfare costs at the business cycle frequency. Fiscal policy can mitigate this loop, but only by moving distortionary taxes. Consumption-tax rules deliver the largest welfare gains, whereas deficit-based rules can generate excessive tax volatility and large welfare losses.
abstract_zh: 我们研究了当银行持有长期公共债务时，主权风险波动如何传导至实体经济。利用意大利数据，我们将利差隐含的违约概率分解为系统性债务驱动成分和捕捉主权风险认知变化的外生成分。我们将这一分解嵌入一个包含受约束金融中介机构和内生违约风险的定量新凯恩斯模型中，该模型求解至三阶，并通过模拟矩估计法进行估计。更高的感知违约风险会降低主权债券价格，削弱银行净值，收紧中介约束，并抑制投资和产出。由于违约风险也会对债务动态做出反应，经济衰退通过主权-银行循环放大了主权风险。我们发现，主权风险冲击解释了约五分之一的产出波动以及商业周期频率下约三分之一的福利成本。财政政策可以缓解这一循环，但只能通过调整扭曲性税收来实现。消费税规则带来最大的福利收益，而基于赤字规则可能引发过度的税收波动和巨大的福利损失。
title: Sovereign Risk Shocks and Fiscal Rules
title_zh: DP21800 主权风险冲击与财政规则

abstract: This paper examines how local governments adjust public budgets following immigration-induced demographic change. It argues that office-seeking incumbents reallocate fiscal resources towards newcomers if these are expected to become voters within a short time horizon. Such adjustments are constrained by uncertainty within governing coalitions over who will capture any resulting electoral gains. The argument is evaluated using data from 290 Swedish municipalities between 2014 and 2023. Empirically, the analysis relates annual changes in budget shares across 11 expenditure categories to annual changes in the local non-EU foreign-born population share. The findings show that larger increases in the non-EU population share are associated with budgetary reallocation towards spending areas that are particularly relevant to these groups. Ideological differences between left- and right-leaning governing coalitions do little to condition these reallocations, whereas broader coalitions exhibit weaker fiscal adjustment. The paper contributes to public choice and political economy research by showing that fiscal responses to demographic change take the form less of uniform expansion than of strategic budget recomposition, and that such adjustment is weaker where coalition partners are uncertain about the distribution of electoral gains.
abstract_zh: 本文考察了地方政府如何根据移民引发的人口结构变化调整公共预算。研究认为，谋求连任的现任官员会倾向于将财政资源重新分配给新移民群体，前提是这些群体有望在短期内成为选民。此类调整受到执政联盟内部不确定性的制约——各方难以预判谁能最终获取由此产生的选举收益。基于2014至2023年间瑞典290个市镇的数据，本文通过实证分析将11类支出项目的年度预算份额变化与当地非欧盟裔外国出生人口占比的年度变动相关联。研究发现，非欧盟裔人口占比增幅较大的地区，其预算会向与该群体特别相关的支出领域倾斜。左翼与右翼执政联盟之间的意识形态差异对此类预算调整的影响甚微，而更广泛的执政联盟则表现出较弱的财政调整力度。本文对公共选择与政治经济学研究的贡献在于：揭示财政对人口结构变化的反应并非表现为均等扩张，而是呈现战略性预算重组特征；同时指出，当联盟伙伴对选举收益分配存在不确定性时，此类调整的力度会显著减弱。
title: Office-seeking under demographic change: immigration, coalition government, and municipal budget reallocation in Sweden
title_zh: 人口变化下的职位追求：瑞典的移民、联合政府与市政预算再分配

abstract: Given the background of global ecological civilization construction, understanding the impact of environmental policies on corporate green innovation is of great significance. Based on a constructed theoretical model, this study employs a Double Machine Learning (DML) model to examine the impact of the new Environmental Protection Law on green technology innovation in resource-based enterprises, using sample data from Chinese resource-based listed companies from 2008 to 2024. The findings of this study include: (1) The new Law has a positive impact on green technology innovation in resource-based enterprises. This conclusion remains robust after tests, including those addressing endogeneity. (2) The local government environmental attention and the corporate environmental information disclosure constitute the mechanisms through which the new Law affects green technology innovation in resource-based enterprises. (3) The positive impact of the new Law on green technology innovation in resource-based enterprises is more pronounced when the chairman or executives of the enterprise hold Communist Party membership or possess a digital professional background, or when the enterprise is located in a key environmental protection city or an economically developed eastern region of China. abstract_zh: 在全球生态文明建设背景下，理解环境政策对企业绿色创新的影响具有重要意义。基于构建的理论模型，本研究采用双机器学习（DML）模型，以2008至2024年中国资源型上市企业为样本，检验新《环境保护法》对资源型企业绿色技术创新的影响。研究发现：（1）新《环境保护法》对资源型企业绿色技术创新具有正向影响，该结论在包括内生性处理在内的多项检验后依然稳健。（2）地方政府环境关注度与企业环境信息披露构成新《环境保护法》影响资源型企业绿色技术创新的作用机制。（3）当企业董事长或高管具有中共党员身份或数字专业背景，或企业位于环保重点城市或经济发达的东部地区时，新《环境保护法》对资源型企业绿色技术创新的正向影响更为显著。关键词：新《环境保护法》；绿色技术创新；地方政府环境关注度；企业环境信息披露 JEL分类：O32 O38 K23 致谢：作者对文中所有观点和见解承担全部责任。黄钊：数据整理、形式分析、方法论、初稿撰写。李柯南：方法论、形式分析、概念构思、审阅修订。唐凌霄：形式分析、项目管理。所有作者：共同参与论文撰写并批准最终投稿版本。

abstract: China hosts the world’s largest and fastest-growing ocean economy, yet it now confronts heightening external trade risks driven by global growing instability. To understand its potential risk from external shocks, this study evaluates the dependence of China’s ocean economy from both forward and backward perspectives and assesses the potential impacts of a U.S.A.–China decoupling based on a provincial ocean economy input–output table. The findings indicate that: 1) the forward external dependence (0.12) is higher than its backward external dependence (0.08), revealing that China’s ocean economy is more sensitive to fluctuations in external market demand than to disruptions in the external supply. 2) The external dependence exhibits significant regional and sectoral heterogeneity. While Guangdong and Shanghai show high external dependence, incorporating HHI concentration reveals that Jiangsu, Liaoning, and Shandong possess greater structural vulnerability. Industries such as marine shipbuilding (forward) and marine chemical (backward) are the most externally exposed industries. 3) The U.S.A.–China decoupling would significantly reduce total output of China’s ocean economy, particularly in marine transport and chemicals; however, scenario simulations confirm that global trade substitution can effectively mitigate a substantial portion of these losses. These findings provide policy insights for managing external risks and strengthening industrial resilience. KEYWORDS: China’s ocean industries external dependence ocean economy input-output table U.S.A–China decoupling JEL CLASSIFICATION: D57 R15
abstract_zh: 中国拥有全球规模最大、增长最快的海洋经济，但当前全球不稳定加剧使其面临日益严峻的外部贸易风险。为理解外部冲击的潜在风险，本研究基于省级海洋经济投入产出表，从前向与后向两个维度评估中国海洋经济的外部依赖度，并测算中美脱钩的潜在影响。研究发现：1）前向外部依赖度（0.12）高于后向外部依赖度（0.08），表明中国海洋经济对外部市场需求波动的敏感度高于外部供给中断。2）外部依赖度呈现显著的区域与行业异质性。广东和上海的外部依赖度较高，但引入赫芬达尔指数（HHI）集中度分析后，江苏、辽宁和山东的结构脆弱性更为突出。海洋船舶制造（前向）与海洋化工（后向）是外部暴露程度最高的行业。3）中美脱钩将显著降低中国海洋经济总产出，尤其对海洋运输和化工行业冲击最大；但情景模拟证实，全球贸易替代可有效弥补大部分损失。上述结论为应对外部风险、增强产业韧性提供了政策启示。关键词：中国海洋产业；外部依赖度；海洋经济；投入产出表；中美脱钩 JEL分类：D57；R15

abstract: Prior studies have not fully examined the factors associated with the global CO 2 transfer network driven by information and communication technology (ICT) investments (GCNI). We employ a multi-regional input-output model, complex network analysis, and an exponential random graph model to explore the evolution and formation mechanisms of the GCNI between 2000 and 2020 from the perspective of foreign direct investment (FDI) motivations. The results indicate that the GCNI has become increasingly interconnected. CO 2 transfer relationships exhibit significant reciprocity and triadic closure characteristics. Larger and more open markets are more likely to receive CO 2 transfer relationships, while similar markets are more likely to establish such relationships. Vertical factors associated with receiving CO 2 transfer relationships evolve from abundant natural resources to low-cost labour, and eventually to highly skilled labour. Regions with stricter environmental regulations and higher corporate tax rates are more likely to initiate these relationships. Our findings suggest that FDI motivation-related factors are closely associated with the geographical pattern of ICT investment-driven emission transfers. These associations may be informative for investment-related emission disclosure, carbon accounting, and discussions of carbon responsibilities and sustainable ICT development in the digital era.
abstract_zh: 以往研究尚未充分探讨与信息和通信技术（ICT）投资驱动的全球二氧化碳转移网络（GCNI）相关的因素。我们采用多区域投入产出模型、复杂网络分析和指数随机图模型，从外国直接投资（FDI）动机的视角，探究2000年至2020年间GCNI的演化与形成机制。结果表明，GCNI的互联性日益增强。二氧化碳转移关系呈现出显著的互惠性和三元闭合特征。市场规模更大、开放程度更高的经济体更易成为二氧化碳转移关系的接收方，而相似的市场之间则更倾向于建立此类关系。与接收二氧化碳转移关系相关的垂直因素，从丰富的自然资源逐步演变为低成本劳动力，最终转向高技能劳动力。环境规制更严格、企业税率更高的地区更可能发起此类关系。我们的发现表明，与FDI动机相关的因素与ICT投资驱动的排放转移地理格局密切相关。这些关联可能为投资相关的排放披露、碳核算，以及数字时代碳责任与可持续ICT发展的讨论提供参考信息。

abstract: The rapid digitalisation of banking and the widespread use of social media are transforming competition for retail deposits. Using US branch-level data, this column shows that digital banks pay higher deposit rates and pass policy rate changes through to depositors more quickly than traditional banks. It also finds that stronger social media activity further increases the responsiveness of deposit rates by accelerating information diffusion and heightening depositor attention. These developments strengthen monetary policy transmission while raising important questions for banks' funding strategies, deposit franchise values and competition in increasingly digital financial markets.
abstract_zh: 银行业快速数字化与社交媒体的广泛使用，正重塑零售存款市场的竞争格局。基于美国分行层面数据，本专栏研究表明：数字银行提供的存款利率更高，且将政策利率变动传导至储户的速度快于传统银行。研究还发现，社交媒体活跃度的提升通过加速信息扩散、增强储户关注度，进一步提高了存款利率的响应弹性。这些变化在强化货币政策传导机制的同时，也对银行的资金策略、存款特许权价值及日益数字化的金融市场中的竞争格局提出了重要议题。
authors: Michael Brei, Giulio Cornelli, Leonardo Gambacorta, Boris Hofmann
title: Digital banks, social media, and the competition for deposits

abstract: Globally declining birth rates have, over the last seven decades, slowed population growth and raised average ages. This column argues that despite widespread economic pessimism, historical cross-country and US commuting zone data point to no impact of ageing populations on aggregate GDP or earnings growth. Countries with lower birth rates have higher GDP growth per working-age adult, and US commuting zones with lower birth rates have faster wage growth. The growth-reducing potential of demographic slowdowns is countered by faster technological change. While future demographic changes will occur at greater speed and scale, the economic record suggests that current pessimism is premature.
abstract_zh: 过去七十年间，全球生育率持续下降，导致人口增长放缓、平均年龄上升。本文认为，尽管普遍存在经济悲观情绪，但历史跨国数据与美国通勤区数据表明，人口老龄化对总体GDP或收入增长并无显著影响。生育率较低的国家，其劳动年龄人口的人均GDP增速更高；生育率较低的美国通勤区，工资增长也更快。人口增速放缓对增长的潜在抑制作用，已被更快的技术变革所抵消。尽管未来人口结构变化的速度与规模将更为显著，但经济史实表明，当前的悲观情绪为时过早。
authors: Daron Acemoglu, David Autor, Keelan Beirne, Andrew Scott
title: Baby busts and GDP booms: Demographic change and the macroeconomy

abstract: This paper documents a socioeconomic gradient in adult labor market penalties stemming from a single chronic and treatable childhood health shock in a country with universal access to healthcare. Using childhood onset Type 1 Diabetes, Danish administrative registry data, and causal forests, we estimate substantial variation in the employment and earnings penalties at age 30. These penalties vary systematically with parental income and maternal educational attainment. Our findings help explain the income-health gradient and have important implications for policy discussions related to the design of healthcare systems.
abstract_zh: 本文记录了在全民医保国家中，单一慢性且可治疗的儿童期健康冲击对成年劳动力市场惩罚的社会经济梯度。利用儿童期发病的1型糖尿病、丹麦行政登记数据及因果森林方法，我们估计出30岁时就业与收入惩罚存在显著差异。这些惩罚随父母收入及母亲教育程度呈现系统性变化。研究结果有助于解释收入-健康梯度现象，并对医疗体系设计相关的政策讨论具有重要启示。
title: Childhood Health Shocks and the Intergenerational Transmission of Inequality

abstract: We combine detailed information on US temporary trade barriers during 1989-2020 with input-output data to study the effects of trade protection along supply chains. We focus on measures imposed against China, which has been the main target of trade protection during the last decades. To deal with endogeneity concerns, we use an instrumental variable strategy, exploiting changes in the identity of swing states across presidential terms and heterogeneous exposure to these political shocks across industries. We find that politically motivated trade protection generates winners and losers: it fosters employment growth in protected industries, but hampers employment growth in downstream industries.
abstract_zh: 我们结合1989-2020年美国临时贸易壁垒的详细信息与投入产出数据，研究贸易保护在供应链中的影响。重点关注针对中国的措施——过去几十年间，中国一直是贸易保护的主要目标。为应对内生性问题，我们采用工具变量策略，利用总统任期更迭中摇摆州身份的变化以及各行业对这些政治冲击的异质性暴露程度。研究发现，政治驱动的贸易保护产生了赢家与输家：它促进了受保护行业的就业增长，但抑制了下游行业的就业增长。

abstract: Given labor informality in developing countries, addressing employment shocks is challenging. We study Indonesia’s new approach for on-demand online applications for temporary cash assistance and online job training. Through 20 lotteries over two years, 11 million beneficiaries were selected. In nationwide, representative surveys matched with administrative data, most beneficiaries report not receiving the assistance, with no detectable impacts on employment or consumption. In contrast, survey data from applicants with working phones reveal high reported take-up and higher incomes. The results suggest that while flexible, on-demand assistance has potential, design features that allow for flexibility could hinder receipt and, thus, impact.
abstract_zh: 鉴于发展中国家普遍存在的非正规就业现象，应对就业冲击颇具挑战性。我们研究了印度尼西亚针对临时现金援助和在线职业培训的新型按需在线申请模式。通过两年间20轮抽签，共筛选出1100万受益人。在匹配行政数据的全国代表性调查中，多数受益人报告未收到援助，且未发现对就业或消费产生可检测的影响。相比之下，对拥有可用电话的申请者进行的调查数据显示，其报告领取率较高且收入水平更高。研究结果表明，尽管灵活的按需援助具有潜力，但允许灵活性的设计特征可能阻碍实际领取，进而影响政策效果。
title: On-Demand Assistance: Experimental Evidence from Indonesia
title_zh: 按需援助：来自印度尼西亚的实验证据

abstract: This paper measures how cost-sharing impacts older low-income patients, exploiting a disconti-nuity in eligibility for a prescription drug subsidy for those who lose access to the Medicaid-linked program. Higher drug prices resulting from subsidy loss lead to a 40% reduction in prescription expenditures, driven by a 16% quantity reduction of prescriptions filled. Patients economize on purchases of higher-priced drugs, irrespective of their health benefits. For example, patients re-duce insulin purchases by 35%. There is no evidence that cost-sharing prompts switching from branded drugs to generics. This behavior suggests that cost-sharing reduces prescription accessibility without enhancing cost-effectiveness.
abstract_zh: 本文利用与医疗补助计划挂钩的处方药补贴资格中断现象，测度成本分摊对老年低收入患者的影响。补贴资格丧失导致药价上涨，使处方药支出减少40%，其中处方药配药量下降16%是主要驱动因素。患者会减少高价药品的购买，而不考虑其健康效益。例如，患者将胰岛素购买量减少35%。没有证据表明成本分摊会促使患者从品牌药转向仿制药。这一行为表明，成本分摊在未提升成本效益的情况下，反而降低了处方药的可及性。
title: Prioritizing Benefit? How Low-Income Patients Respond to Prescription Cost-Sharing
title_zh: 优先考虑收益？低收入患者如何应对处方费用分摊

abstract: This paper assesses the effects of corporate tax cuts on small firms and their workers. Following a reform in Quebec, Canada, firms receiving tax cuts expand and their workers' earnings increase com- pared to workers and firms without tax cuts. We estimate that overall workers bear 35 percent of the tax burden, with larger inci- dence falling on those with ownership in the companies they work through increased profits. Additionally, workers across each ter- cile of the within-firm earnings distribution beneffit from tax cuts, possibly because fair-wage concerns matter when after-tax profits rise due to close interactions among workers in small corporate environments.
abstract_zh: 本文评估了企业减税对小企业及其员工的影响。基于加拿大魁北克省的一项改革，享受减税政策的企业规模扩大，其员工收入相较于未受减税政策影响的企业及员工有所增长。我们估算，员工整体承担了35%的税负，其中更大比例的税负通过利润增长落到了持有所在企业股权的员工身上。此外，在企业内部收入分布的各三分位组中，员工均从减税中获益，这可能是因为在小企业环境中员工间的密切互动使得公平工资关切在税后利润上升时发挥了作用。
title: Impacts of Corporate Tax Cuts on Firms and Workers: Evidence from Small Businesses
title_zh: 企业减税对企业与工人的影响：来自小企业的证据
